gaps.sentence: This job calls ___ someone with patience.
gaps.explanation: call for = require, demand (circumstances call for action).

gaps.sentence: They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: The gang gave ___ the stolen paintings to a gallery.
gaps.explanation: give away = give free of charge, or reveal (a secret).
